overview_description.description: Poliglota was founded in 2012 and aims at changing the way people learn languages. It gathers people in small social groups in coffee places instead of classrooms, led by expert teachers, and using a social methodology. It is based on a program of innovative and social activities, focusing on social skills that create faster and more effective learning progress. Poliglota won the Avonni award for Innovation, was selected by the IDB as one of the disruptive educational innovations in Latin America, and is selling over USD $2 M in language plans, while they keep expanding their model.

product.name: Group Language Classes
product.description: Scheduled group sessions led by a coach for small groups of students to practice and learn languages through conversation.

product.name: Private Language Classes
product.description: One-on-one language lessons with a coach tailored to individual learning needs and pace.

product.name: Conversation Club
product.description: Open online sessions for free-form language practice with community members without a coach.

product.name: Language Level Assessment
product.description: Online tests and evaluations to determine a learner's proficiency level in a language based on speaking and listening skills.

product.name: Learning Platform and Materials
product.description: A digital platform providing access to study materials, progress tracking, and session management for language learners.

product.name: Corporate Language Training
product.description: Customized language training programs for companies, including group and private classes, to improve employee communication skills.
